chant.letra:
[Leader]
What do you like doing?
[Kids]
I like riding my bike! Riding my bike!

[Leader]
What do you like doing?
[Kids]
I like reading! Reading and drawing!

[Leader]
What do you like doing?
[Kids]
Playing outside! Playing till dark!

[Leader]
And on a rainy day?
[Kids]
Watching TV! One video game!

[All]
Skateboard, kite and park and fun —
school is over, off we run!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Iris likes drawing on the path,
Tino likes riding his bike.
Aiko likes reading on the bench
and Bruno likes whatever we like.

[Chorus]
I like playing, you like reading,
she likes flying a kite!
After the bell the day begins —
we've got until it's night!

[Verse 2]
Some like gymnastics, some like skiing,
volleyball or martial arts.
Athletics, rowing, skateboard, park —
everybody starts.

[Chorus]
I like playing, you like reading,
she likes flying a kite!
After the bell the day begins —
we've got until it's night!

[Bridge]
After 'like' the verb gets '-ing':
I like watching, I like doing everything.

[Chorus]
I like playing, you like reading,
she likes flying a kite!
After the bell the day begins —
we've got until it's night!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How do you run?
[Kids]
Fast! We run fast!

[Leader]
How do you jump?
[Kids]
High! We jump high!

[Leader]
How do you throw?
[Kids]
Far! We throw far!

[Leader]
How do you play?
[Kids]
Well! We play well together!

[All]
Run and jump and throw and catch —
one big team, one big match!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Warm up first and stretch your muscles,
then the race is going to start.
Tino runs it very fast,
Iris throws it very hard.

[Chorus]
Run fast, jump high,
catch it, kick it, try!
The winner gets a medal
and we clap them to the sky!

[Verse 2]
Stamina is not a sprint,
it's the will to keep on going.
The team that claps the loudest
is the team that keeps on growing.

[Chorus]
Run fast, jump high,
catch it, kick it, try!
The winner gets a medal
and we clap them to the sky!

[Bridge]
How do you play? You play WELL.
That's the word the adverbs tell.

[Chorus]
Run fast, jump high,
catch it, kick it, try!
The winner gets a medal
and we clap them to the sky!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
When is football?
[Kids]
On Monday! On Monday!

[Leader]
When is music?
[Kids]
On Wednesday! After lunch!

[Leader]
When is the trip?
[Kids]
On Friday! First thing!

[Leader]
And when do we rest?
[Kids]
At the weekend! Saturday, Sunday!

[All]
First, then, next, after that —
finally the week is done!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
On Monday Sofía draws a map,
on Tuesday Erik builds a light.
On Wednesday Valentina tells a story
and it lasts us half the night.

[Chorus]
First, then, next, after that,
finally the week is through!
Ask me when and I will tell you:
on a day that's good for you!

[Verse 2]
On Thursday Mateo finds his bag,
on Friday everybody sings.
Today is busy, tomorrow's free
and the weekend brings good things.

[Chorus]
First, then, next, after that,
finally the week is through!
Ask me when and I will tell you:
on a day that's good for you!

[Bridge]
Not 'in Monday' — say it right:
ON Saturday and ON Sunday night.

[Chorus]
First, then, next, after that,
finally the week is through!
Ask me when and I will tell you:
on a day that's good for you!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Would you like a sandwich?
[Kids]
Yes, please! I'm hungry!

[Leader]
Would you like some juice?
[Kids]
Yes, please! A whole bottle!

[Leader]
Would you like a biscuit?
[Kids]
Yes, please! Two biscuits!

[Leader]
Would you like the last cake?
[Kids]
No, thank you. You have it!

[All]
Apple, banana, water, blanket —
spread it out and let's begin it!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Would you like a sandwich, Erik?
Would you like some water too?
The blanket's on the grass already
and the sky is very blue.

[Chorus]
Would you like, would you like —
ask it kindly, ask it right!
Apple, banana, cake and biscuits,
hungry hands and appetite!

[Verse 2]
When I grow up, says Valentina,
I'd like to be a scientist.
I want to be an engineer, says Erik,
an artist, says Iris, on her list.

[Chorus]
Would you like, would you like —
ask it kindly, ask it right!
Apple, banana, cake and biscuits,
hungry hands and appetite!

[Bridge]
Next year, when I grow up,
I'm going to study what I love.

[Chorus]
Would you like, would you like —
ask it kindly, ask it right!
Apple, banana, cake and biscuits,
hungry hands and appetite!

18.gramatica: It's + adjective, put on / take off

chant.letra:
[Leader]
It's cold!
[Kids]
Put on your coat! Put on your hat!

[Leader]
It's snowing!
[Kids]
Put on your boots! And your sweater!

[Leader]
It's windy!
[Kids]
Hold your scarf! Hold it tight!

[Leader]
Now it's warm!
[Kids]
Take it off! Take it all off!

[All]
Umbrella, raincoat, sunglasses too —
the weather says what you should do!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
It's cool outside this morning,
so I put my sweater on.
It's cold beside the water
and my gloves have gone.

[Chorus]
Put it on, take it off,
the weather changes fast!
Coat and hat and boots and scarf —
how long will this warm spell last?

[Verse 2]
The snow came down on Saturday,
the wind came up at three.
Sofía brought her raincoat
and her sunglasses, hopefully.

[Chorus]
Put it on, take it off,
the weather changes fast!
Coat and hat and boots and scarf —
how long will this warm spell last?

[Bridge]
An umbrella in your bag
is never, ever a mistake.

[Chorus]
Put it on, take it off,
the weather changes fast!
Coat and hat and boots and scarf —
how long will this warm spell last?

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How do you go to school?
[Kids]
By bus! I go by bus!

[Leader]
How do you go to school?
[Kids]
By bike! I go by bike!

[Leader]
How do you go to school?
[Kids]
By car! By train!

[Leader]
And you?
[Kids]
I walk! I walk every day!

[All]
Driver, stop and seat and window —
twenty minutes, here we go!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I go to school by bus each morning,
Aiko goes by bike instead.
Samu walks it in ten minutes
with his ticket in his head.

[Chorus]
How do you go? How do you go?
By bus, by bike, by car, by train!
The seat beside the window
is the best one, that is plain!

[Verse 2]
The driver knows us all by name,
he waits at every stop.
The journey isn't difficult,
it's easy and it's never boring, not a drop.

[Chorus]
How do you go? How do you go?
By bus, by bike, by car, by train!
The seat beside the window
is the best one, that is plain!

[Bridge]
What's your favourite way to travel?
Interesting or boring — say!

[Chorus]
How do you go? How do you go?
By bus, by bike, by car, by train!
The seat beside the window
is the best one, that is plain!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Where do you buy bread?
[Kids]
At the bakery! At the bakery!

[Leader]
Where do you borrow books?
[Kids]
At the library! At the library!

[Leader]
Where do you swim?
[Kids]
The swimming pool! Of course!

[Leader]
And where do you go when you're ill?
[Kids]
The hospital! Or the chemist!

[All]
Cinema, museum, market, bank —
all around the town we walk!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The library is on the corner,
the cinema is by the square.
The supermarket's always open
and the bank is over there.

[Chorus]
Where is it? Where is it?
All around the town!
School and shop and swimming pool —
we know it upside down!

[Verse 2]
The playground's past the sports centre,
the museum's past the school.
The café serves the best hot chocolate
and the restaurant is full.

[Chorus]
Where is it? Where is it?
All around the town!
School and shop and swimming pool —
we know it upside down!

[Bridge]
The bookshop, chemist, market, hospital —
point and name them, name them all!

[Chorus]
Where is it? Where is it?
All around the town!
School and shop and swimming pool —
we know it upside down!

21.gramatica: in, on, under, behind, next to, between

chant.letra:
[Leader]
The cat — in or on?
[Kids]
In! In the box!

[Leader]
The cat — under or above?
[Kids]
Under! Under the table!

[Leader]
The cat — behind or in front of?
[Kids]
Behind! Behind the door!

[Leader]
And now?
[Kids]
Between! Between Luna and the chair!

[All]
Here, there, next to, above —
find the cat, that's all it takes!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
It's in the box, it's on the shelf,
it's under Erik's chair.
It's behind the open door
and then it isn't there.

[Chorus]
In, on, under, behind,
next to, between, above!
Say exactly where it is
and you will find what you love!

[Verse 2]
Animals can hunt and swim,
some can fly and some can roar.
Some hibernate the winter through
behind a hidden door.

[Chorus]
In, on, under, behind,
next to, between, above!
Say exactly where it is
and you will find what you love!

[Bridge]
'Here' is close and 'there' is far —
in front of you is where you are.

[Chorus]
In, on, under, behind,
next to, between, above!
Say exactly where it is
and you will find what you love!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who has got curly hair?
[Kids]
Lía! Lía has got curly hair!

[Leader]
Who has got glasses?
[Kids]
Erik! Erik has got glasses!

[Leader]
Who has got a beard?
[Kids]
Pablo! Sofía's grandfather!

[Leader]
And how do you feel today?
[Kids]
Excited! Proud! A little nervous!

[All]
Young and old and short and strong —
everybody here belongs!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The person who has got green eyes,
the person with the curly hair,
the person who is always early —
guess them all, if you dare.

[Chorus]
She has got, he has got,
glasses, freckles, hair so long!
Pretty, strong, young or old —
nobody here gets it wrong!

[Verse 2]
Carmen is Valentina's aunt,
she's excited, never bored.
Mateo's nervous, then he's proud,
then confused and then restored.

[Chorus]
She has got, he has got,
glasses, freckles, hair so long!
Pretty, strong, young or old —
nobody here gets it wrong!

[Bridge]
Upset or surprised or scared —
say the feeling, say it clear.

[Chorus]
She has got, he has got,
glasses, freckles, hair so long!
Pretty, strong, young or old —
nobody here gets it wrong!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
In the village — what was there?
[Kids]
There was a river! There was a bridge!

[Leader]
In the village — what was there?
[Kids]
There was a church! There was a path!

[Leader]
And at night?
[Kids]
There were stars! So many stars!

[Leader]
And was it noisy?
[Kids]
No! It was quiet! Fresh and quiet!

[All]
Field and river, bridge and star —
that's the village, that's how they are!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There was a village up the valley
where my grandparents used to live.
There was a river and a bridge
and all the time they had to give.

[Chorus]
There was one, there were many,
long before this song!
Field and path and church and star —
that is where I belong!

[Verse 2]
We visit them in summer,
we help them bake the bread.
The air is fresh, the night is quiet
and the stars are overhead.

[Chorus]
There was one, there were many,
long before this song!
Field and path and church and star —
that is where I belong!

[Bridge]
To protect a place, to serve, to heal —
small words, but they are real.

[Chorus]
There was one, there were many,
long before this song!
Field and path and church and star —
that is where I belong!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who has to wash the dishes?
[Kids]
I do! I have to!

[Leader]
Who has to feed Luna?
[Kids]
Mateo! He has to!

[Leader]
Who has to water the plants?
[Kids]
Sofía! Every Tuesday!

[Leader]
And who takes out the rubbish?
[Kids]
Everybody! In turns!

[All]
Sweep the floor and clean the table —
one big team and we are able!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I have to wash the dishes,
Erik has to sweep the floor.
Sofía has to feed the husky
and clean up something more.

[Chorus]
Helpful hands, one big team,
every job gets done!
Table, rubbish, plants and dishes —
share it and it's fun!

[Verse 2]
We take the tram to grandma's house,
the underground, the ferry too.
Mateo takes his scooter
and arrives at half past two.

[Chorus]
Helpful hands, one big team,
every job gets done!
Table, rubbish, plants and dishes —
share it and it's fun!

[Bridge]
'I have to' isn't 'I want to' —
but it feels good when it's through.

[Chorus]
Helpful hands, one big team,
every job gets done!
Table, rubbish, plants and dishes —
share it and it's fun!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's the matter?
[Kids]
I've got a cold! A bad cold!

[Leader]
What's the matter?
[Kids]
I've got a cough! Cough, cough!

[Leader]
What's the matter?
[Kids]
A headache! And a temperature!

[Leader]
So what do you need?
[Kids]
Bed! Rest! And hot soup!

[All]
Medicine and sleep and rest —
tomorrow you will feel your best!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
What's the matter, Valentina?
I have got a stomach-ache.
What's the matter, little Mateo?
I'm ill and I'm awake.

[Chorus]
What's the matter? Tell me true,
and we will find the thing to do.
Bed and soup and rest and medicine —
better soon, and better, better, better soon!

[Verse 2]
The appointment is on Tuesday,
the temperature is down.
One more day of soup and stories
and we'll walk you back to town.

[Chorus]
What's the matter? Tell me true,
and we will find the thing to do.
Bed and soup and rest and medicine —
better soon, and better, better, better soon!

[Bridge]
A cough, a cold, a headache too —
say what hurts and we'll help you.

[Chorus]
What's the matter? Tell me true,
and we will find the thing to do.
Bed and soup and rest and medicine —
better soon, and better, better, better soon!
